acceptedAnswer.text: About a week from signed agreement to live calls. We do the heavy lifting. You give us your hours, services, and pricing on a 20-minute kickoff call.

mainEntity.name: Will it sound like a robot?

acceptedAnswer.text: Call (918) 359-2644 and judge for yourself. Most people can't tell.

mainEntity.name: What happens if it can't answer something?

acceptedAnswer.text: It transfers to your cell or any number you pick. You decide which questions trigger a transfer.

mainEntity.name: What if I want to change what it says?

acceptedAnswer.text: Free updates anytime within your plan. Tweaks usually go live within 24 hours.

mainEntity.name: Do I have to keep my current phone number?

acceptedAnswer.text: No. We can give you a new local number, or set up call forwarding from your existing number to ours. You don't lose your number either way.

mainEntity.name: What if it doesn't book any appointments?

acceptedAnswer.text: 30-day money-back guarantee. If it captures zero bookings in 30 days, you get your money back, no questions.

mainEntity.name: Can it call my customers, not just answer?

acceptedAnswer.text: Outbound calling (reminders, confirmations, follow-ups) is on the roadmap. Inbound is the focus today.
